platforms: Android (Pixel); LINE; Samsung Galaxy; Windows 11; iPhone
expected_result: Text appears larger right away; the sample text changes as the slider moves.
common_failure: Very large text can make buttons hard to tap; some Android apps ignore the font size setting.

expected_result: The update installs (the device may restart) and Settings shows the device or app is up to date.
common_failure: A 'not enough space' message stops the update; menu names differ by phone maker.

expected_result: Incoming calls ring loud enough to hear.
common_failure: The iPhone is in Silent mode (orange switch or Action button), so it only vibrates.

core_task: Turn off notifications from an app or chat
expected_result: Alerts from that app or chat stop; the app itself keeps working.
common_failure: In LINE, @mentions can still notify after a chat is muted; Android menu names vary.

expected_result: The app's icon disappears; it can be reinstalled later.
common_failure: On iPhone the icons start to jiggle instead of showing a menu (use the minus sign, then Done).

expected_result: A small preview appears and the screenshot is saved to Photos or the Screenshots folder.
common_failure: The two-button press doesn't register; on Windows, Print Screen only copies to the clipboard.

expected_result: A checkmark appears next to the network and the Wi-Fi symbol shows at the top of the screen.
common_failure: The network doesn't appear in the list, or the password is rejected.

core_task: Add a contact or LINE friend
expected_result: The person appears in Contacts or the LINE friends list.
common_failure: LINE phone-number search finds nothing because the person hasn't allowed being added by phone number.

expected_result: Calls or messages from that person stop; they are not notified.
common_failure: On iPhone a blocked caller can still leave a voicemail (without a notification).

expected_result: One message reaches everyone, and everyone sees the replies.
common_failure: An iPhone group with Android users won't send unless MMS Messaging is on; in LINE, people must be friends first.

expected_result: The family member can see the user's location in Find My or Google Maps.
common_failure: Google Maps sharing needs the recipient's Gmail address (otherwise use a link); Find My needs iOS 15 or later on both phones.

core_task: Attach a photo to an email
expected_result: The attachment's name appears in the message before sending.
common_failure: Files over 25 MB are added as a Google Drive link instead of an attachment.

core_task: Someone claiming to be family or a friend asks for money
expected_result: The user pauses, calls the person at a number they already have, and doesn't send money.
common_failure: The voice sounds real (voice cloning), or money or codes were already sent.

core_task: Someone claiming to be an authority calls
expected_result: The user hangs up and checks with the agency using its official number.
common_failure: The user already shared a Social Security number or bank details (see IdentityTheft.gov / 165).

core_task: Check or report a suspicious message or link
expected_result: The user doesn't click, checks through the official site or number, and reports it (7726, ReportFraud.ftc.gov, or 165).
common_failure: The user already clicked and entered card details or a code.

expected_result: The user refuses gift cards, wire transfers, crypto, or private transfers, and talks to someone they trust.
common_failure: The user already paid: contact the gift card company or bank right away and report it.

expected_result: The account has a strong, unique password and 2-step verification turned on.
common_failure: Account recovery doesn't work right away (try again in a few days); never share codes with anyone.
